args.summary: The v2.3.1 production deploy of checkout-api began failing health checks (error rate 0.18, unhealthy status). A rollback to v2.3.0 — the most recent release healthy in production — was executed across all production regions. The first rollback attempt partially failed (completed us-east, halted at us-west by an orchestrator error), leaving mixed versions; a retry completed the rollout to v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Post-rollback verification: all regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate 0.002. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure requires investigation before any redeploy.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

## Rollback: checkout-api v2.3.1 → v2.3.0
1. **Diagnosed**: Release history showed v2.3.1 (production) was unhealthy; v2.3.0 was the most recent release healthy in production, so it was the rollback target.
2. **First rollback attempt**: Partially failed — completed in us-east but halted in us-west due to an orchestrator error, leaving regions on mixed versions (us-east: v2.3.0; us-west/eu-west: still v2.3.1, error rate 0.18, unhealthy).
3. **Retried rollback**: Succeeded — all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) now on v2.3.0.
4. **Verified**: checkout-api is healthy again across all regions with error rate down to 0.002.

## Incident
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api: rollback of unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy to v2.3.0 in all regions"), on-call has been paged. (The first attempt timed out; I retried with the same idempotency key, so no duplicate incident was created.)

**Note for follow-up**: The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure needs investigation before any redeploy of that version.
